location_exception_reason: Prefabricated accommodation units are manufactured in specific regional hubs (Ahmedabad, Thane, Faridabad) and deployed across India; buyer procurement decisions are influenced by logistics, delivery lead time, and local manufacturing compliance — location in title signals origin credibility and supply chain proximity.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in titles — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently; removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Prefabricated Accommodation Cabin Manufacturer' leaves the product definition complete and unchanged.
